title.narrative: TRANSFORM Phase 2 CORE spend: scaling early-stage business models in Africa and Asia with support from Unilever and EY

description.narrative: This activity TRANSFORM Phase 2 CORE spend: scaling early-stage business models in Africa and Asia with support from Unilever and EY is a component of TRANSFORM - Transformative Market Based Models for low income household needs reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £18,118,272. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Technological research and development, Research/scientific institutions, Environmental research, Medical research, Agricultural research.

mailing-address.narrative: Public Enquiry Point, Abercrombie House, Eaglesham Road, East Kilbride, Glasgow G75 8EA
